editorial.blurb: Gordo's Tamales serves the best chunky, saucy tamales in the area—soft dough that'll have you nearly eating the wrapper.
editorial.insiderTip: Order ahead if possible and arrive during quieter hours; the rajas con queso and frijoles con queso are the standouts worth the wait.

topDishes.note: Just delicious, especially when the beans are fried in pork's lard
Soft and delicious tamales, the best in the area
Great dough with savory green sauce
